title: Lancasters ME625 and ND981
memorial_details: description: Plaque inscription: (97 Squadron badge)/ IN THE SURROUNDING FIELDS LIE THE REMAINS OF LANCASTERS/ ME625 AND ND981 OF 97 SQUADRON RAF BOMBER COMMAND/ WHICH CAME TO REST WITH THEIR CREWS,/ THE RESULT OF A TRAGIC ACCIDENT/ 23RD JUNE 1944/ ME625/ (Names)/ ND981/ (Names)/ UNVEILED BY THE RELATIVES FOR THE 70TH ANNIVERSARY./ PER ARDUA AD ASTRA
